name: dm-website
title: devmade Studio Front-Door
description: The public homepage for the devmade studio — introduces the studio and its two product lines, with case studies and a build log, and routes visitors to the right product.
audience: Prospective clients and visitors looking for the devmade studio — its vibe-rescue service, its apps-for-business subscription, and its work.
useCases: A prospective client lands on the hub, reads what devmade does, and follows the call-to-action into the vibe-rescue intake
A visitor browses case studies and the build log to gauge the studio’s work before reaching out
Someone interested in the apps-for-business line opens that page and subscribes via the intake form
A reader clicks through from a product to the deeper portfolio and pattern library

dataPrivacy.storage: Static marketing site; no user accounts.
dataPrivacy.forms: The intake and subscribe forms post to the shared utilities API to deliver an email; a hidden honeypot field screens bots.
dataPrivacy.hosting: Served from Cloudflare Workers static assets.
